_comment: Astesia Anti-Pattern Registry. Every rule is born from an observed agent mistake (origin). Never delete a rule without an ADR. New rules enter via skills/lint-ratchet/SKILL.md.

rules.description: Hallucinated import: relative path does not exist on disk.
rules.fix: Point the import at a real file or create the module via the proper wave.

rules.description: Layer breach: controller/route/handler imports an ORM or DB client directly.
rules.fix: Move the data access into a Repository and call it through a Service.

rules.description: Unbounded column fetch: SELECT * is banned in production code.
rules.fix: Select only the required columns explicitly.

rules.description: astesia-debt marker without an `upgrade:` clause (vague debt).

rules.fix: Read it from the environment (process.env / config module) and document it in .env.example.

rules.description: Explicit `any` weakens the type system (Trust Pyramid L1).
rules.fix: Use a precise type, `unknown` + narrowing, or a Zod-inferred type.

rules.description: console.log in source; use the structured logger.
N+1 Database Query: database or repository call executed inside a loop (.map, for, while).
rules.fix: Batch fetch records with an IN clause, JOIN, or eager loading outside the loop.
